# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update with the latest upstream rendering corrections. Linux font fallback may choose a different fontconfig face; applications requiring deterministic typography should use an explicit or bundled typeface.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change text metrics or glyphs. Use an explicit family and style or a bundled typeface when deterministic font selection matters.

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestone m153** — The bundled renderer advances to m153 and incorporates the latest upstream bug, correctness, and buffer-upload fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

HarfBuzzSharp receives native build-warning cleanup in this release.
